title: Talent Acquisition Business Partner (TABP) at Pune WFO
description:
The Talent Acquisition Business Partner (TABP) will be responsible for managing end-to-end talent acquisition activities across corporate functions, real estate projects, construction sites, and business operations. The role requires a strong understanding of real estate and construction industry manpower requirements, talent availability, recruitment channels, market intelligence, and stakeholder expectations. The incumbent will partner with business and functional leaders to understand current and future manpower requirements, develop effective sourcing strategies, ensure timely closure of positions, and build a sustainable talent pipeline for critical and niche positions. 
 Strategic Talent Acquisition & Business Partnership Partner with business heads, functional leaders, project heads, and department managers to understand current and future manpower requirements. Translate business manpower plans into structured recruitment strategies and hiring priorities. Drive annual manpower planning and recruitment budgeting in coordination with HR and business stakeholders. Understand project-wise manpower requirements based on project lifecycle, construction milestones, and business expansion plans. Advise stakeholders on talent availability, market compensation, hiring feasibility, and recruitment timelines. Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure effective hiring outcomes. 
 End-to-End Recruitment Management Independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requisition initiation to candidate onboarding. Manage hiring across corporate, project, site, sales, CRM, engineering, procurement, finance, legal, administration, and support functions. Handle lateral hiring, mid-management recruitment, niche hiring and leadership-level mandates as assigned. Prepare and validate job descriptions, competency requirements, and candidate evaluation parameters in coordination with hiring managers. Screen profiles, conduct preliminary HR interviews, coordinate technical and managerial assessments, and facilitate selection decisions. Manage interview scheduling, feedback tracking, offer approvals, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts. Ensure timely joining, documentation, and onboarding coordination. Maintain candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process to minimise offer dropouts and candidate attrition before joining. 
 Real Estate & Construction Industry Hiring 
 Manage recruitment for industry-specific roles, including but not limited to: a. Engineering & Projects: Project Managers, Construction Managers, Site Engineers, Civil Engineers, MEP Engineers, Planning Engineers, QA/QC Engineers, Safety Officers and Project Coordinators. b. Architecture & Design: Architects, Interior Designers, Design Managers, Structural Consultants and BIM professionals. c. Sales & Marketing: Sales Managers, Relationship Managers, Business Development Executives, Channel Partner Managers and Marketing Professionals. d. CRM & Customer Experience: CRM Managers, Customer Relationship Executives, Possession Managers, Customer Experience Professionals and Handover Coordinators. e. Contracts & Procurement: Procurement Managers, Purchase Executives, Contracts Managers, Quantity Surveyors, Billing Engineers and Commercial Professionals. f. Finance & Accounts: Finance Managers, Accounts Managers, Costing Professionals and Project Finance Executives. g. Legal & Liaison: Legal Managers, Documentation Executives, Liaisoning Professionals and RERA Compliance Professionals. h. Corporate & Support Functions: HR, Administration, IT, MIS, Company Secretarial and other business support positions. Knowledge of RERA-related roles, construction project execution, real estate sales cycles, project-based manpower deployment and site hiring requirements will be an advantage. 
 Talent Sourcing & Market Intelligence Develop and maintain a robust talent pipeline for recurring, critical, and business-sensitive positions. Leverage multiple sourcing channels, including Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, employee referrals, professional networks, recruitment agencies and industry connections. Identify and map talent from competing real estate developers, construction companies, infrastructure organisations and allied industries. Conduct talent mapping and competitor benchmarking for critical and leadership positions. Build and maintain an active database of qualified candidates across key functional domains. Establish effective relationships with external recruitment consultants and sourcing partners. Monitor industry hiring trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor practices. 
 Recruitment Operations & Governance Ensure all hiring activities are initiated through approved Manpower Requisition Forms (MRFs). Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, interview feedback records, and offer approval documentation. Monitor recruitment turnaround time (TAT) against defined hiring timelines. Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, approval matrices, compensation structures, and HR procedures. Coordinate background verification, pre-employment documentation and joining formalities. Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate periodic hiring reports and dashboards. Ensure adherence to recruitment budgets and effective utilisation of external recruitment agencies. Maintain confidentiality and integrity of candidate information and recruitment decisions. 
 Recruitment Analytics & Performance Management Track and report key recruitment performance indicators. Analyse recruitment bottlenecks and recommend process improvements. Monitor hiring effectiveness, sourcing channel performance and recruitment costs. Prepare monthly recruitment dashboards and management reports. Recommend process automation and improvements in recruitment systems and workflows. 
 Industry/ Relevant Experience Minimum 5-7 years of overall experience in Human Resources, with substantial hands-on experience in Talent Acquisition. Prior experience in the Real Estate, Construction, Infrastructure, Engineering, or EPC industry is strongly preferred. Experience in managing end-to-end recruitment across corporate offices and project/site operations. Demonstrated experience in mid-management, technical, and specialised hiring. Experience in stakeholder management, recruitment planning, talent mapping and vendor management. Strong exposure to recruitment metrics, hiring dashboards and ATS/HRMS platforms. 
 Educational background MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification preferred. Graduate degree in any discipline is acceptable with relevant recruitment experience. Additional certifications in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Analytics, or HR Management will be an advantage. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong understanding of end-to-end talent acquisition processes. Excellent candidate sourcing, screening, and assessment capabilities. Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills. Good understanding of real estate and construction industry roles and functional requirements. Effective negotiation and offer management skills. Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship management abilities. Analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making. Ability to manage multiple vacancies and competing hiring priorities. Strong follow-up, coordination and execution capabilities. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and ATS/HRMS tools. High degree of ownership, accountability, confidentiality, and professional integrity. 
 Role precision & ideal candidate profile An ideal candidate would be a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition professional with 7+ years of experience, preferably within a reputed real estate developer or construction organisation. The candidate should possess a strong combination of technical recruitment expertise, business understanding, stakeholder management and execution capabilities, with the ability to independently manage recruitment requirements across corporate and project-level operations. The incumbent is expected to operate as a business-oriented Talent Acquisition professional rather than merely a recruitment coordinator. The role demands independent ownership of assigned hiring mandates, proactive engagement with stakeholders, an understanding of project and business priorities, and the ability to deliver quality talent within agreed timelines and budgets. The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to transition from transactional recruitment execution to a consultative talent acquisition business partnering approach.
